# E07 build plan

Planning only. Independent plan review precedes implementation. No implementation, hardware, test or CI result is claimed. Dispatch of affected work waits for the requests below; a disabled path is safe interim behavior, never completed acceptance.

## Basis and build order

E07 has no `docs/tdd/E07.md`, `docs/requests/E07.md` or `docs/tdd/reviews/E07.*` at inspection. The specification is `docs/product/tdd/E07.md:1`, its three work packages, R08/R26 (`docs/product/PRD.md:484`, `docs/product/PRD.md:502`), SYSTEM and Part A decisions. No design is created or edited.

`hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, the three adapter packages and general generated contracts are absent. Existing `contracts/` and `config/` contain pharmacy artifacts, which remain outside E07. There is no device driver or clinical importer to reuse. Other epic task ownership was inspected; recheck `docs/build/*/tasks.json` immediately before dispatch because planning is concurrent.

| Task | Owned paths | Build and connection |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | `adapters/oximeter/` | Validated clinical source ingress: Pulse Oximeter BLE input, the oximeter manual handoff, and the generic clinical import input of E07-02. Own its tests, project configuration and device manual. |
| T2 | `adapters/cuff/` | Blood Pressure BLE boundary and manual handoff, its tests, project configuration and device manual. |
| T3 | `adapters/thermometer/` | Health Thermometer BLE boundary and manual handoff, its tests, project configuration and device manual. |
| T4 | `eval/scenarios/E07/` | Real HTTP/SQLite and browser acceptance, explicit-profile test assets, protocol evidence and the scenario trace. Depends on T1, T2 and T3 for execution. |

Ownership is from `docs/SYSTEM.md:134`, `docs/SYSTEM.md:138` and section 6.1, rather than a nonexistent design section 13. Directory allocations include only files belonging to that concern. T1 is the sole author of the clinical import input; T2/T3 do not copy it or import T1's private implementation. Its physical home is the already owned oximeter project, avoiding a speculative new hub module or unassigned adapter project. All four tasks have disjoint paths. Test data files live only in T4's eval directory; unit tests generate inputs from validated configuration. No E07 task edits shared contracts, runtime configuration, hub modules, UI, supervisor, runner, fixture or AI use log.

T1/T2/T3 can proceed in parallel once E01's generated models/toolchain and the applicable approved source contracts exist. They do not depend on each other's implementation. SYSTEM 9 makes E01/E02/E05 hard dependencies for acceptance; E27 is optional at runtime but its real implementation is required to prove kit-count integration. Before feature integration, consume complete agreed provider protocols and `crew_health.kernel.testing` under SYSTEM 10. Never create replacements for an absent provider. T4 may prepare its tests before the packages are complete, but its acceptance gates wait for all three and the actual E01/E02/E05/E03/E21 providers. Import confirmation additionally requires the approved E09 boundary.

## Design decisions

- Seams: adapters are separate processes, use generated wire models and HTTP, and never import hub feature implementations (`docs/SYSTEM.md:1661`). E05 owns `CapabilityQueries`, `MeasurementCommands`, requests/attempts/gaps and dispatch; E01 owns `ObservationCommands` and observation acceptance; E02 owns identity, tokens and device identity state; E27 owns kit computation. These are ownership names, not permission to infer signatures. E05's complete acquisition, readiness and producer-proof signatures remain pending in `docs/requests/E05.md:57` and `docs/tdd/E05.md:141`.
- Transport: use `recordAttempt`, POST `/v1/measurement-requests/{request_id}/attempts`, with `AttemptCreate`, the authenticated adapter token and approved acquisition proof (`docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:4936`, `docs/product/api/schemas/requests.schema.json:781`). A failure has a reason and no fabricated value. `recordObservation`, POST `/v1/observations`, with `ObservationCreate`, remains E01's manual route (`docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:4410`). E07 supplies attribution, not a second route or form. The readings route in DEPLOYMENT 3.4 is the E23 habitat `AdapterReadingBatch`, not a patient-ingest shortcut (`docs/product/api/schemas/requests.schema.json:1834`).
- Source handling: use `bleak` and the documented Bluetooth SIG families in BUILD-CHARTER 2 and DEPLOYMENT 3.4. Service IDs 0x1822, 0x1810 and 0x1809 identify families, not proof that a kit model is compatible. No characteristic UUID, flag, byte layout, device-specific calibration, quality limit or blood-pressure component code is guessed. Pin primary protocol and actual model evidence before enabling that path. Unsupported hardware remains unavailable, with a readable physical device still eligible for its separately configured manual method.
- Imports: one bounded FHIR R4 4.0.1 input boundary follows BUILD-CHARTER 2. Preserve source-specific measurements and interpretations through generated approved types; never turn an ECG interpretation into a numeric Observation, free-text context or a claim of connected ECG hardware. Device imports and E09 private reports have separate ownership. Confirmation, source-span attribution and clinician attribution are prerequisites, not an automatic acceptance step. Missing typed contracts block E07-02 acceptance.
- Shared mechanisms: reference SYSTEM 5.1 identifiers, 5.2 clock/segments, 5.3 mission time, 5.4 quantities/UCUM, 5.5 errors, 5.6 release loading, 5.7 UoW/events, 5.8 command ledger/receipts, 5.9 audit, 5.10 health/tasks/evaluation, 5.11 bounds and 5.12 composition. These execute in their owning hub providers. SYSTEM 6.2 permits workers to consume generated models, not private hub modules. A worker-safe injected clock, configuration and durable-send binding still needs the coordinator decision below; no copied kernel, transaction, retry or recovery mechanism is authorized.
- Time: retain actual observed, entered and received times, source clock/segment/capture revision and origin. An untrusted device timestamp or unknown segment never becomes trusted by stamping arrival. E01 normalizes under SYSTEM 5.2. LIVE/SIM freshness uses corrected observed time and its whole uncertainty interval; D14's REPLAY exception applies only to its stated channel semantics, not arbitrarily to imported clinical records. Retry/backoff/health durations are elapsed; a source's explicit examination timestamp is an absolute fact. Relative timers use shared correction-aware anchors across restarts; mission-day changes do not relabel old observations.
- Failure containment: primary is a documented connected device; dissimilar backup is explicit manual entry from a real readable instrument, or existing manual pulse measurement through E01/E05. A broken or missing instrument has no instrument result. Fail safe is unavailable/not measured, with the reason, age and last value kept historical. Fixed help works before sign-in and during save failure through E26/E03/E20. Never claim an unsaved manual entry is accepted. Optional model, ground and tablets are absent in the fallback run.

| Bounds to inventory before enabling a worker | Source and owner |
|---|---|
| Call timeout, health interval, restart count/window, maximum backoff, RSS and CPU | `workers.<name>.*`, SYSTEM 3/5.11; exact descriptors and launch binding require R-E05-2 and P-E07-3 below. |
| Body bytes and task admission, retries, lease and input/result bytes | `commands.max_bytes`, `tasks.*`, SYSTEM 5.11; E01/E05 enforce admission before physical work. |
| Send-buffer bytes/entries, sequence persistence, import file/resource/component/depth limits, BLE packet and notification admission | Missing worker-specific descriptors and shared recovery binding, P-E07-3. Unknown bounds prevent starting that optional input. No silent truncation or eviction of unacknowledged evidence. |
| SQL rows/statement bytes, pending evaluation retry, scheduler batches | `storage.*`, `evaluation.*`, `scheduler.*`, SYSTEM 5.11; E01 owns enforcement, not worker SQL. |

## End to end evidence

T4 owns every row below. Use production `create_app(settings)` with real temporary SQLite, authenticated HTTP, real configuration, consent, assignment, repositories, UoW, ledger and audit. Browser assertions use Playwright against that running hub and E03/E05's actual UI. No mocks, dependency overrides or direct SQL seeds inside the hub. External BLE/file sources use the documented adapter boundary and explicitly selected eval fixtures; production and eval run the same decoder and sender. Missing harness support is a blocked prerequisite, never a skip, xfail or success from an empty result. Counterpart modules are real whenever their behavior is asserted.

| Test trace | What it proves |
|---|---|
| R08, E07-01/03, V11/V53, D21's unavailable clause | Independently disconnect/kill each family and remove the radio; the real request becomes unavailable with no new value. The manual form still records a genuinely read value with device attribution. Broken equipment produces no invented manual result; E25 routine Not available creates no Observation. |
| R08, V08/V09/V25/V40/V47/V72 | Wrong subject, unpaired station, wrong token/device/generation and mixed origin fail before patient acceptance. Separate LIVE presenter and SIM Mara; no cross-person receipt/chart/event leak or baseline/participation contamination. Test current grant revocation during send and replay; an incapacitated subject still has E01/E02's verified-officer manual path and fixed help. |
| R08, V13 | Cancel before start, during capture, after physical completion and racing ingest. Physical stopped/cannot-stop/unknown are truthful; late real evidence is retained and quarantined, never silently discarded or accepted by task completion. Retrying an unknown physical receipt never starts another measurement blindly. |
| R08/R25 invariant, V14/V15/V16/V35 | Unsupported units, malformed/nonfinite packets and old/unknown/future timestamps cannot become a current accepted normal. Retry the identical command/sequence after response loss and after 24 hours; one logical record remains. Changed body/target/parameters conflict. Kill before/after source reservation, capture persistence, hub commit and acknowledgment; restart both processes. Disk-full/I/O/integrity faults acknowledge nothing and retain pending evidence. Verify original attribution, receipt, audit head and authorized refetch. |
| R08, E07-02, V18/V19/V20/V21/V38/V78, D12/D30/D39's unresolved-gap clauses | Import real-format numeric instrument findings and a typed source-attributed ECG interpretation using the approved confirmation path. Wrong patient/date/unit and unconfirmed draft cannot enter accepted context. Preserve source and confirmer separately, original time and historical status. No ECG hardware appears, no automatic diagnosis or gap closure, no inferred ocular finding or personal radiation dose. Whole cross-epic D assertions remain their owners' evidence. |
| R08/R26, V69/V75/V81, D01/D27's source clauses and D34/D43's link-independence clauses | On the laptop, with model/ground/devices/tablets absent, manual record entry and fixed help work. Connection and import status/origin are served honestly. Change a sourced nonsafety device label in a scratch accepted release: output and real UI change with no code edit; open work retains its pins. Corrupt/missing update retains last good release. Up/delayed/down ground states do not change device/manual results; adapter code has no ground reader. |
| R26, E07-03; AGENTS invariants 2/5/6/7/8 | The integration manifest distinguishes connected LIVE, manual LIVE, import, REPLAY and SIM operation with evidence and unmeasured statuses. Recorded/SIM packets run through production code and never claim measured hardware compatibility or calibration. Keep two disagreeing sources and their methods; never average or let a camera veto the manual reading under Q8. |

Each family also needs property tests for its parser and unit mapping, plus independent protocol golden cases and source-checked clinical quality golden cases. Test zero, negative, empty, maximum, truncation, reserved/status fields, saturation, stuck values, rate of change and a changed unit/model. Missing multi-sample evidence remains insufficient. Config-derived inputs alone do not prove the medical expectation. E01's observation policy performs clinical acceptance; E07 never duplicates or weakens it.

## Design deviations

| Source conflict or absence | Winning rule | Build |
|---|---|---|
| E07 brief's TDD handoff, no design/reviews | This planning assignment; SYSTEM 4 | Plan directly from the brief; no invented design sections, review verdicts or frozen-design edit. There are no E07 design-review comments to resolve. |
| DEPLOYMENT 3.4 readings path versus patient observations | SYSTEM 4.2 ownership; actual `AdapterReadingBatch` schema | Patient results use approved E05 attempts/E01 records. Habitat readings remain E23. |
| Base `recordAttempt` returns full MeasurementRequest | SYSTEM 8.3; E02 3.4; R-E05-4 | Do not enable adapter ingestion until a minimal generated receipt and current replay authorization exist. Never invent a redacted invalid MeasurementRequest. |
| Brief names AdapterManifest; CONTRACTS names Device; neither has a standalone wire schema | SYSTEM 6.5 and AGENTS 1.9 | Request generated definitions and provenance/identity ownership; no handwritten shared DTO or configuration document. |
| Base numeric Observation cannot represent ECG interpretations | CONTRACTS 2; E07-02; no fabrication invariant | Require an approved typed finding/confirmation boundary; no zero, numeric encoding or arbitrary context workaround. |
| Old package review notice and stale unit/error/idempotency wording | Part A D1/D3/D5/D6/D7/D12/D13, Q1/Q8/Q18; SYSTEM 5/8 | Review absence is labeled; all source/quality/identity checks remain. Use effective unit mappings, ErrorEnvelope, durable identity and savepoint evaluation. An adapter never changes warnings. |

## Gates and handoff

Each task lists exact scoped test, ruff, strict mypy and import-linter commands using SYSTEM 6's uv projects. T4 runs all family suites, the E07 eval folder, hub shared guards and the full hub suite after fixes. E21's published standalone runner commands are currently proposed prerequisites (`docs/tdd/E21.md:768`); missing support is reported, not replaced by engine-root pytest. Python test/project configuration is selected explicitly. No UI product files are owned, so E03/E05 retain pnpm lint/typecheck/test; T4 consumes their passing build for Playwright.

Before greenlight, require all three E07 work packages and matrix rows, independent review resolved within the build cap, real CI, AI use log entries and honest hardware evidence. A protocol decoder test is numerical verification; actual device compatibility, measured calibration, clinical validation and mission acceptance have separate evidence statuses. No physical kit compatibility, clinical validation or mission acceptance is inferred here.
